40022951.author: पदार्थः
40022951.content: वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, राघवः Rama, प्रत्यभाषत replied, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तां her, वरवर्णिनीम् of excellent complexion.

40022951.author: Translation
40022951.content: Indeed, when spoken to thus by Valmiki, Rama, having seen Sita of excellent complexion in the midst of the people, replied with folded hands.

40022952.author: पदार्थः
40022952.content: एवम् thus, एतत् this, महाभाग O great fortunate one, यथा as, वदसि you say, धर्मवित् O knower of dharma, प्रत्ययः conviction, तु indeed, मम my, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, तव your, वाक्यैः by words, अकल्मषैः sinless.

40022952.author: Translation
40022952.content: O great fortunate one, O knower of dharma, this is indeed as you say, and my conviction is established by your pure words, O Brahmana.

40022953.author: पदार्थः
40022953.content: प्रत्ययस्तु assurance but, पुरा formerly, वृत्तो occurred, वैदेह्याः of Vaidehi, सुरसन्निधौ in the presence of gods, शपथस्तु oath but, कृतस्तत्र made there, तेन by that, वेश्म home, प्रवेशिता was made to enter, लोकापवादो public scandal, बलवान् powerful, येन by which, त्यक्ता abandoned, हि indeed, मैथिली Maithili.

40022953.author: Translation
40022953.content: Although Vaidehi's purity was previously proven by an oath taken in the presence of the gods, and she was admitted back into the home, the powerful public scandal compelled me to abandon Maithili.

40022954.author: पदार्थः
40022954.content: सेयं she this, लोकभयाद् from fear of public opinion, ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, अपापेत्यभिजानता knowing her to be sinless, परित्यक्ता abandoned, मया by me, सीता Sita, तद्भावन् that you, क्षन्तुमर्हति should forgive.

40022954.author: Translation
40022954.content: O Brahman, knowing her to be sinless, I abandoned Sita out of fear of public opinion, and for this, you should forgive me.

40022955.author: पदार्थः
40022955.content: जानामि I know, चेमौ and these two, पुत्रौ sons, मे my, यमजातौ twins, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, शुद्धायां pure, जगतो of the world, मध्ये in the midst, मैथिल्यां in Maithili, प्रीतिरस्तु let there be affection, मे my.

40022955.author: Translation
40022955.content: I know that these two, Kusha and Lava, are my twin sons, and I desire that my affection for Maithili, who is pure in the eyes of the world, be restored.

40022956.author: पदार्थः
40022956.content: अभिप्रायं intention, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, रामस्य of Rama, सुरसत्तमाः best among gods, सीतायाः of Sita, शपथे in the oath, तस्मिन् in that, महेन्द्राद्या Mahendra and others, महौजसः greatly powerful.

40022956.author: Translation
40022956.content: Having understood Rama's intention regarding Sita's oath, the greatly powerful best among gods, led by Mahendra (Indra), prepared to act.

40022957.author: पदार्थः
40022957.content: पितामहं Grandfather (Brahma), पुरस्कृत्य having made the leader, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled.

40022957.author: Translation
40022957.content: All of them, indeed, assembled, making Grandfather Brahma their leader.

40022958.author: पदार्थः
40022958.content: आदित्याः Adityas, वसवः Vasus, रुद्राः Rudras, हि indeed, अश्विनौ the two Ashvins, समरुद्गणाः along with the groups of Maruts, गन्धर्वाप्सरसः Gandharvas and Apsaras, च and, एव indeed, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः had assembled.

40022958.author: Translation
40022958.content: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Ashvins along with the Maruts, Gandharvas, and Apsaras, all indeed had assembled there.

40022959.author: पदार्थः
40022959.content: साध्याः Sadhyas, च and, विश्वेदेवाः Vishvedevas, च and, सर्वे all, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, नागाः Nagas, सुपर्णाः Suparnas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, ते they, सर्वे all, हृष्टमानसाः with joyful minds, सीताशपथसम्भ्रान्ताः agitated by Sita's oath, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः had assembled.

40022959.author: Translation
40022959.content: The Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, all great sages, Nagas, Suparnas, and Siddhas, all of them with joyful minds, agitated by Sita's oath, had indeed assembled there.

40022960.author: पदार्थः
40022960.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवान् the gods, ऋषीन् and the sages, च and, एव indeed, राघवः Rama, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रत्ययः faith/conviction, मे is for me, नरश्रेष्ठाः O best among men, ऋषिवाक्यैः by the words of the sages, अकल्मषैः which are faultless.

40022960.author: Translation
40022960.content: Having seen the gods and sages, Rama spoke again, saying, "O best among men, I have conviction in the faultless words of the sages."

40022961.author: पदार्थः
40022961.content: शुद्धायाम् in the pure one, जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, वैदेह्याम् in Vaidehi (Sita), प्रीतिः affection/love, अस्तु let there be, मे for me.

40022961.author: Translation
40022961.content: Let my affection for Vaidehi, who is pure in the midst of the world, be firm.

40022962.author: पदार्थः
40022962.content: ततः then, वायुः the wind, शुभः auspicious, पुण्यः sacred, दिव्यगन्धः with divine fragrance, मनोरमः delightful, तत् that, जनौघम् multitude of people, सुरश्रेष्ठः best among gods (referring to Vayu, the god of wind), ह्लादयामास delighted, सर्वतः from all sides.

40022962.author: Translation
40022962.content: Then, the auspicious, sacred, divinely fragrant, and delightful wind, the best among gods (Vayu), delighted that multitude of people from all sides.

40022963.author: पदार्थः
40022963.content: तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, इव as if, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, निरैक्षन्त they beheld, समागताः assembled, मानवाः humans, सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः from all kingdoms, पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, यथा as.

40022963.author: Translation
40022963.content: People gathered from all kingdoms beheld that wonderful and inconceivable sight, just as they would have in the Krita Yuga.

40022964.author: पदार्थः
40022964.content: सर्वान् all, समागतान् assembled ones, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीता Sita, काषायवासिनी clad in ochre robes, अब्रवीत् she spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यम् words, अधोदृष्टिः with downcast eyes, अवाङ्मुखी with face turned downwards.

40022964.author: Translation
40022964.content: Having seen all the assembled people, Sita, clad in ochre robes, spoke with folded hands, her eyes and face cast downwards.

40022965.author: पदार्थः
40022965.content: यथा just as, अहम् I, राघवात् from Rama, अन्यम् another, मनसा by mind, अपि even, न not, चिन्तये I think, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.

40022965.author: Translation
40022965.content: Sita prayed, "Just as I do not think of any other man than Rama even in my mind, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

40022966.author: पदार्थः
40022966.content: मनसा by mind, कर्मणा by action, वाचा by speech, यथा just as, रामम् Rama, समर्चये I worship, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.

40022966.author: Translation
40022966.content: Sita prayed, "Just as I worship Rama with my mind, actions, and speech, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

40022967.author: पदार्थः
40022967.content: यथा just as, एतत् this, सत्यम् truth, उक्तम् spoken, मे by me, वेद्मि I know, रामात् than Rama, परम् superior, न not, च and, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.

40022967.author: Translation
40022967.content: Sita prayed, "Just as this truth has been spoken by me and I know no one superior to Rama, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

40022968.author: पदार्थः
40022968.content: तथा thus, शपन्त्यां while swearing, वैदेह्यां by Vaidehi, प्रादुरासीत् appeared, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, भूतलात् from the surface of the earth, उत्थितं risen, दिव्यं divine, सिंहासनम् throne, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40022968.author: Translation
40022968.content: As Vaidehi was thus swearing, a wonderful, divine, and unsurpassed throne emerged from the surface of the earth.

40022969.author: पदार्थः
40022969.content: ध्रियमाणं being held, शिरोभिः by heads, तु and, नागैः by Nagas, अमितविक्रमैः of immeasurable valor, दिव्यं divine, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा bodies, दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः adorned with divine jewels.

40022969.author: Translation
40022969.content: This divine throne was being held by the heads of Nagas of immeasurable valor, who themselves possessed divine bodies adorned with divine jewels.

40022970.author: पदार्थः
40022970.content: तस्मिन् on that, तु and, धरणी the Earth, देवी goddess, बाहुभ्यां with two arms, गृह्य taking, मैथिलीम् Maithili, स्वागतेन with a welcome, अभिनन्द्य having greeted, एनाम् her, आसने on the seat, च and, उपवेशयत् made her sit.

40022970.author: Translation
40022970.content: Then, Goddess Earth, taking Maithili with her two arms, greeted her with a welcome and made her sit upon that throne.

40022971.author: पदार्थः
40022971.content: ताम् her, आसनगतां seated on the throne, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रविशन्तीं entering, रसातलम् the netherworld, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, अविच्छिन्ना uninterrupted, दिव्या divine, सीताम् upon Sita, अवाकिरत् showered.

40022971.author: Translation
40022971.content: As Sita, seated on the throne, was seen entering the netherworld, an uninterrupted divine shower of flowers fell upon her.

40022972.author: पदार्थः
40022972.content: साधुकारः an acclamation of well done, च and, सुमहान् very great, देवानां of the gods, सहसा suddenly, उत्थितः arose, साधु well done, साधु well done, इति thus, वै indeed, सीते O Sita, यस्याः whose, ते your, शीलम् character, ईदृशम् such.

40022972.author: Translation
40022972.content: A very great acclamation of "well done" suddenly arose from the gods, praising, "Well done, well done, O Sita, whose character is indeed of such purity!"

40022973.author: पदार्थः
40022973.content: एवम् thus, बहुविधाः various, वाचः words, हि indeed, अन्तरिक्षगताः celestial, सुराः gods, व्याजह्रुः uttered, हृष्टमनसः with joyful minds, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीताप्रवेशनम् Sita's entry.

40022973.author: Translation
40022973.content: The celestial gods, with joyful minds, uttered various words upon witnessing Sita's entry into the earth.

40022974.author: पदार्थः
40022974.content: यज्ञवाटगताः those in the sacrificial enclosure, च and, अपि also, मुनयः sages, सर्वे all, एव indeed, ते those, राजानः kings, च and, नरव्याघ्राः best among men, विस्मयात् from astonishment, न not, उपरेमिरे ceased.

40022974.author: Translation
40022974.content: All those sages and kings, who were like tigers among men, present in the sacrificial enclosure, did not cease their astonishment.

40022975.author: पदार्थः
40022975.content: अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, च and, भूमौ on the earth, च and, सर्वे all, स्थावरजङ्गमाः stationary and moving beings, दानवाः demons, च and, महाकायाः of huge bodies, पाताले in the netherworld, पन्नगाधिपाः lords of serpents.

40022975.author: Translation
40022975.content: All stationary and moving beings in the sky and on the earth, along with the huge-bodied demons and the lords of serpents in the netherworld, were present.

40022976.author: पदार्थः
40022976.content: केचित् some, विनेदुः roared, संहृष्टाः greatly delighted, केचित् some, ध्यानपरायणाः absorbed in meditation, केचित् some, रामम् Rama, निरीक्षन्ते gazed at, केचित् some, सीताम् Sita, अचेतनाः stunned.

40022976.author: Translation
40022976.content: Some, greatly delighted, roared; some were absorbed in meditation; some gazed at Rama, while others, stunned, looked at Sita.

40022977.author: पदार्थः
40022977.content: सीताप्रवेशनम् Sita's entry, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तेषाम् among them, आसीत् there was, समागमः a gathering, तत् that, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, इव as if, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, समम् entirely, सम्मोहितम् bewildered, जगत् the world.

40022977.author: Translation
40022977.content: Upon witnessing Sita's entry, there was a great gathering of beings, and for a moment, the entire world seemed exceedingly bewildered. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 97 ।। Thus ends the ninety-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
